description: Down-migration registry. Maps up-migrations to their reverse. Used by migration-runner --down to pick the right script. Not every up has a down — gold-standard append-only invariants (audit chain, event store) require explicit dev/staging-only down-flags. See LITFIN-parity item 5.
scope: 10 highest-blast-radius migrations from 0252..0273 (this session). Older migrations get down scripts in follow-up passes.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE land_areas + RLS
CREATE TABLE parcels + RLS (CASCADEs 0254..0260)
CREATE TABLE layout_overrides + RLS
CREATE TABLE agency_missions + RLS (CASCADEs 0267..0270)
CREATE TABLE mission_steps + RLS
CREATE TABLE mission_checkpoints + RLS
CREATE TABLE mission_outcomes + RLS
CREATE TABLE mission_drift_log + RLS
CREATE TABLE tenant_llm_budgets + tenant_llm_budget_caps + index
CREATE TABLE payment_event_store + triggers + functions + indexes + RLS
mappings.notes: Event store is audit substrate for rent + arrears. Production down requires export-then-restore plan.

CREATE TABLE regulator_jurisdictions + ADD COLUMNs tenants.{regulator_set,country_code,primary_currency,default_language} + CHECK constraints + indexes

CREATE TABLE move_in_out_condition_reports + CHECK constraints + RLS
CREATE TABLE maintenance_tasks + maintenance_toolbox_talks + CHECK constraints + RLS

CREATE TABLE maintenance_tasks + maintenance_toolbox_talks + CHECK constraints + RLS (renumbered from 0283 — slot taken by 0283_oauth_action_approvals.sql sibling port; effectively idempotent due to IF NOT EXISTS)
CREATE TABLE discovered_jurisdictions + unique/partial indexes + RLS policy dj_admin_only
mappings.notes: Cache rows are recomputable via the discovery pipeline; safe to drop in dev/staging.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE persons + person_links + personal_memory_cells (federated PKB — NO RLS by design; gated by app.current_person_id GUC + boundary-tagger Chinese-wall)
mappings.notes: personal_memory_cells holds GDPR Art. 4(1) personal data; production redaction MUST go through the GDPR right-to-be-forgotten pipeline (gdpr.schema.ts), not this down script.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE share_links + unique token idx + tenant/entity indexes + RLS policy share_links_tenant_isolation
mappings.notes: Active share links are time-bounded and re-mintable; safe to drop in dev/staging.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE undo_journal + actor/entity/window indexes + RLS policy undo_journal_tenant_isolation
mappings.notes: Undo journal is a transient 5-min reverse buffer; the immutable AI audit chain holds the durable record.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE owner_tabs + updated_at idx + RLS policy owner_tabs_tenant_isolation
mappings.notes: Tab strip is rebuildable from chat + entity history; loss costs the landlord their drawer focus across devices. Production rollback must be coordinated by #ops.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE admin_superpower_pending_approvals + journal/expires indexes + RLS policy admin_four_eye_admin_scope
mappings.notes: Pending approvals are short-lived (24h TTL); cancellation forces operators to re-propose. Production rollback must be coordinated with the platform-admin council.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE owner_style_profiles + tenant-uq + dimension/score CHECKs + tenant_updated index + RLS policy owner_style_profiles_tenant_isolation
mappings.notes: Per-owner learned communication style; rebuildable from subsequent chat turns (the feedback loop re-converges from a neutral default). Dropping it costs the owner their personalised voice until it re-learns.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE courses + course_lessons + course_documents + tenant/owner/status indexes + RLS policies courses_tenant_isolation / course_lessons_tenant_isolation / course_documents_tenant_isolation
mappings.notes: Generated courses are rebuildable from the same domain + scenario inputs, but learner quiz progress (course_lessons quiz_score/status/completed_at) is lost. Production rollback must be coordinated by #ops.

mappings.reverses: ADD COLUMN cases.photos jsonb DEFAULT '[]'
mappings.notes: Drops case intake photo references. Photos promoted into the normalized evidence_attachments table are unaffected; only the lightweight intake-time refs on cases.photos are lost.

mappings.reverses: CREATE TABLE durable_scheduled_wakes + durable_armed_monitors + unique/scan indexes + RLS policies (tenant_isolation + service_role_bypass) + REVOKE anon
mappings.notes: Drops the crash-resilient backing store for the orchestrator's schedule_wake / monitor Decisions. Any armed-but-not-yet-fired wakes/monitors are lost; the supervisor degrades to the storeless in-process fallback (arms lost on restart again). No money/audit data here.

mappings.reverses: ENABLE/FORCE RLS + tenant_isolation_select/modify + service_role_bypass policies on person_links + REVOKE anon; non-partial unique index disbursements_tenant_idempotency_uq (tenant_id, idempotency_key)
mappings.notes: No table/row data is destroyed — person_links rows survive. The down only removes the RLS posture (re-opening the cross-tenant identity-linkage leak) and the redundant atomic-claim arbiter index; the 0174 partial idempotency index is left intact. MUST NOT run in production: disabling RLS re-exposes person→tenant→user PII linkage across tenants.
